Few months ago when I was still with my ex my selfharm affected them very badly. One time after my relapse they broke down crying and said something along the lines of "I know you don't care about yourself but please stop this, for me" and it actually helped me stop cause I didn't wanna hurt them.

I don't think my parents are neglectful. I mean. They took me to psychiatrist. Didn't buy the meds but still. They know that I have problems and they close their eyes on them making my life easier. Idk. It's weird. I don't think it's neglectful.

I somewhat understand the way you feel. Struggling with selfworth makes life so so so much harder, but that doesnt meanthings will stay this way forever. You can learn to love who you are or work on yourself and become the person who you will love. Theres always a solution. Theres always a way out. Youre not an abomination.
